title: Find (⌘K)
bodyHtml:
Find (⌘K)

Search submissions, sessions, speakers, forms, and tasks for the active event.

Open Find

Use ⌘K / Ctrl+K or the top-bar Find control. Search is event-scoped and role-aware (evaluators only see assigned submissions).

Index freshness

The search index rebuilds after mutations via background drain. If results look empty after a big change, wait a moment or use the maintenance rebuild control. Stale index state is normal briefly after edits.

Where this lives in the app

  • /admin (⌘K)

Open these routes on your demo or local host while you follow the steps above.
